connector.name: wcagc - accessibility scanning
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic axe-core accessibility scans (WCAG 2.1 AA, EN 301 549, PDF/UA) via your account.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.wcagc.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wcag-compliance account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WCAGC_MCP_KEY
env.description: A wcagc API key with the mcp:scan scope. Mint one under Settings -> API keys; every plan can, with a daily quota on Free and Starter.

env.name: WCAGC_API_BASE_URL
env.description: The wcagc API to call. Defaults to the hosted API; override only for a self-hosted deployment.
